record.title: Canada COVID restrictions on ordinary tourist entry from United States
record.direction: Inbound to Canada from the United States.
record.movement: Ordinary foreign tourist, recreational and entertainment visitors entering Canada from the United States who did not qualify under a separate family, compassionate, national-interest or other exemption.
record.exceptions: Canadian citizens, permanent residents, protected persons and registered Indigenous persons retained entry rights. Essential work, trade and study continued. Qualifying immediate/extended family, compassionate, national-interest and authorized sporting entrants were exempt under evolving conditions, including some discretionary journeys.
record.enforcement: CBSA documented the policy and continued tourist exclusion before July 5. Statistics Canada retrospectively identifies the August 9 reopening and increased US-resident car entries in CBSA port data; this is not universal gate-level observation.
record.status_observation: Evidence dated in cited sources; no assumption of present status.
record.official_rationale: Limit importation and spread of COVID-19.
record.context: 9 August phase admitted vaccinated US citizens/permanent residents resident in US; 7 September broadened vaccinated access.
record.uncertainty: The interval applies only to ordinary tourist/recreational foreign visitors without another exemption. August 9, 2021 was the first broad tourist relaxation for fully vaccinated US citizens/permanent residents residing in and travelling from the United States; it did not remove all restrictions. Separate family and other discretionary exemptions existed earlier. March 18 was the announcement, while March 21 was the effective land-border start. July 5 quarantine relief was not an ordinary-tourist reopening. Statistical coverage is incomplete and does not identify every entrant as a tourist.

historical.duration_note: Calendar-date difference to the stated partial reopening for the specified category and crossing; not exact hours or universal closure. March 21, 2020 to August 9, 2021 measures the restriction on ordinary foreign tourist/recreational entry without another exemption until the first broad US-resident vaccinated tourist reopening. It does not measure every nonessential foreign journey or total border closure.

followup_reviews.Researcher: GPT-6 Astra Pro /root (baseline half) and /root/verification_recovery (programme-addition half); prior involvement disclosed
followup_reviews.Separate challenger: GPT-6 Astra Pro /root/verification_recovery challenges baseline; /root challenges programme additions; separate same-model contexts with prior involvement disclosed
followup_reviews.Research finding: Retain the included Canadian restriction on ordinary foreign tourist/recreational entry from the US. CBSA implementation and refusal evidence support occurrence, without a claim that all border movement stopped. The selected cohort lacks a separate family, compassionate, national-interest or other exemption. Citizens, permanent residents, protected persons and registered Indigenous persons, and conditional essential/study/sporting groups, are treated according to the official policy descriptions. Retain 21 March 2020–9 August 2021, 506 calendar days, until the first broad vaccinated US-resident tourist relaxation. March 18 announcement, July 5 quarantine relief and September 7 wider foreign admission are distinct. Human disease control is directly supported by the government’s importation/spread explanation. No additional rationale is inferred from traffic statistics. CBSA implementation/advisories, IRCC retrospective, Public Safety exceptions/refusal briefing and Statistics Canada PDF were directly read. The HTML statistics page failed; indexed text and the successful PDF receipt remain distinguished. Aggregate administrative data do not identify every entrant as a tourist. The Canadian-side selected phase remains unlocated. Administrative counts from 111 equipped ports cannot certify every gate, assign locations or imply US-side entry permission.
followup_reviews.Challenge verdict: Accepted within the root decision; see frozen challenge

Accept the baseline challenger’s source-language, goods-attribution and Greek article-number refinements plus the additional limited source readings. The eight new parents require no further factual changes: preserve their cohort, policy/schedule, day-level, unknown-endpoint and location qualifications. This is a completed audit procedure for the sample, not proof every attribute or every record in the register is verified.

release_review.adjudication: Accept the fixed sixteen-parent audit, covering all21currentphases and96claimdomains. Apply seven guarded baseline cell refinements: cancellation/nonimplementation wording forSUP-004, local-resident reopening scope for quarantinedR3-SC-004, and correlated schedule alternatives forSUP-002 so a false0–2day range is not calculated. Retain both quarantine decisions and all existing source/date/continuity/geographic limits. Accept the baseline challenger’s source-language, goods-attribution and Greek article-number refinements plus the additional limited source readings. The eight new parents require no further factual changes: preserve their cohort, policy/schedule, day-level, unknown-endpoint and location qualifications. This is a completed audit procedure for the sample, not proof every attribute or every record in the register is verified.
